notes.title: Stop distribution of Wallpaper Transformer
notes.notes:
Dear customers,

I am sorry to announce that we have already decided to stop the distribution of Wallpaper Transformer from now on.

We're not willing to do this but we have to. The software has been on the store for more than a year, and we've tried our best to make it possible to play games as wallpapers as what the software is aimed for. However, we've found that it's impossible to be compatible with most of the games, since it's too complicated to handle all the situations. Besides, we also find that playing games as wallpapers is not a real market requirement at all, because most people don't care about it, not to mention how hard it is to make it happen. All in all, we conclude that it's best to stop distributing the software if we can't implement the features any more.

Q&A
Q. Will people who already bought the app still be able to use it?
A. Yes, the old users will still be able to use the app.

Q. Does your game rely on any online components on your end? If so, will customers still have access to those features in the future?
A. The software doesn't rely on any server.

Q. Have you communicated the change to your customers yet?
A. I've already published the announcement on Steam community.

Q. If you're selling your product on other stores using Steam keys, you'll want to retire the title from those stores as well.
A. It's not sold on any 3rd party store except Steam in any way, including Steam keys.

Wallpaper Transformer Team

Change log
1. A new UI for wallpaper selection.
2. Dark theme for main user interface.
3. Selecting file path.
4. Built-in support for web page.
5. Built-in support for video files.
6. Autostart when computer starts.
7. Auto run the latest wallpaper when start.
8. Recent played file list for quick access.
9. Support most of the video formats.
10. Hot keys for quick setting wallpaper, hiding taskbar and desktop icons etc.
11. Option of keeping focus on wallpaper.
